Olivia (eng-ml): Quick sync — after the KV eviction incident postmortem, we need to formalize eval additions (regression tests, promptset, load pattern, chaos drills). Can folks pick owners so we can ship by end of sprint?
Maya (eng-ml): I can take the regression suite additions for KV eviction: burst-write + cache-warm scenarios. Will add tests to the regression repo. ETA: next Tue (3 working days).
Liam (eng-sre): I'll own chaos drills and the triage runbook update. Plan: run a chaos drill in staging next Fri, simulate node OOM + partial KV loss. Need a set of test payloads and step-by-step failure injection.
Olivia (eng-ml): @Maya pls also add the new promptset for evals (edge prompts that cause long-context rewinds). Link the promptset in the tracking sheet. @Liam include expected SLO deltas (latency,  p95).
Maya (eng-ml): Copy. Will add promptset + a small harness. Quick example test command I’ll add to the PR description: `pytest tests/eviction/test_kv_eviction.py::test_burst_write --env=staging`
Maya (eng-ml): Question: should the regression run nightly or only on PRs?
Sophia (eng-platform): Recommend nightly smoke + PR gating for the full regression suite. Nightly catches regressions earlier; PR gating prevents landing breakages.
Noah (eng-ml): I'll add load tests targeting prefix/KV cache behavior (50k reqs/min with mixed seq lengths). Need staging capacity details — @Sophia can you provision a 4-GPU short-lived cluster?
Sophia (eng-platform): On it. I'll provision a short-lived staging cluster and post creds in the sheet (one-time creds). Also will add network and KMS notes.
Maya (eng-ml): Summary of action items I'll add to the sheet: regression owner = Maya (regression tests + promptset), chaos drill owner = Liam (runbook + drill), load test owner = Noah, timeline column: regression Wed, promptset Wed, chaos drill Fri, load tests Mon next week.
Liam (eng-sre): :thumbsup: I'll also add a small playbook section "eviction pattern detection" with triage steps and signals to watch (KV miss spike, tail latency bump, cache eviction rate).
IncidentBot: Postmortem updated: https://redwood/pm/kv-eviction — new action items added.
Olivia (eng-ml): Thanks. Please add the Slack thread ts + PR links into the sheet so we can track progress. We'll do a brief review in Monday standup to confirm go/no-go for merging.
Maya (eng-ml): Added PR link and notes. One risk to call out: quantized kernels (int8) might change eviction timing; I'll add an int8 flag to the regression matrix.
Noah (eng-ml): Noted — I'll include int8 runs in the load test matrix as well.
Liam (eng-sre): If any owner needs more time or infra, ping me directly. Otherwise mark items as "in progress" in the sheet and assign watchers.
Olivia (eng-ml): Great — wrap up: owners + due dates on sheet, test harness + promptset in PR, chaos drill scheduled for Fri, load tests early next week. We'll close these action items once PRs land and the nightly runs pass for 48h.
